description: The plot illustrates an ablation study on the HateXplain dataset, displaying variations in precision, recall, and F1-score across different model configurations. The x-axis is labeled "Model Variants" and presents categorical data with the following points from left to right: "Full model (Ours)", "w/o Prompt", "w/o Augmentation", "w/o Attention", and "w/o Prompt & Augmentation". The y-axis is labeled "Metric (%)" and uses a linear scale ranging from 58 to 66, with tick marks spaced at intervals of 2. The line representing Precision is a solid purple line with circular markers; it begins at 65.45 for the Full model (Ours), drops to 61.06 for w/o Prompt, and then steadily increases across the subsequent categories, reaching 62.22 for w/o Augmentation and 64.06 for w/o Attention, to end at 65.44 for w/o Prompt & Augmentation. The line representing Recall is a solid blue line with circular markers; it starts at its highest value of 65.78 for the Full model (Ours), decreases to 59.64 for w/o Prompt, rises to 63.75 for w/o Augmentation, and then continuously declines to 59.17 for w/o Attention, ending at its lowest point of 56.82 for w/o Prompt & Augmentation. The line representing F1-score is a solid brown line with circular markers; it starts at 65.56 for the Full model (Ours), decreases to 60.16 for w/o Prompt, increases to 62.63 for w/o Augmentation, and then steadily declines across the remaining variants, passing through 59.67 for w/o Attention to end at 57.74 for w/o Prompt & Augmentation.
